## Change / 修改内容

Describe the editorial improvement and the affected documents. / 说明编辑改进及受影响文档。

## Verification / 检查情况

List the files checked and the actual checks performed. / 列出检查过的文件与实际执行的检查。

## Contributor checklist / 贡献者清单

- [ ] I opened [github.com](https://github.com) in a browser and the home page loaded. / 我已用浏览器打开 GitHub 且首页加载成功。
- [ ] I understand that page access does not establish professional expertise. / 我理解页面可访问不代表具备专业能力。
- [ ] I have added no business code, executable scripts, workflows, `src/`, package manifest, or runtime dependency. / 我没有添加业务代码、可执行脚本、工作流、`src/`、包清单或运行依赖。
- [ ] English and Chinese documents and visual variants remain consistent. / 中英文文档及视觉版本保持一致。
- [ ] I checked links and Markdown, and rendered any changed diagrams or visual assets. / 我检查了链接与 Markdown，并渲染了修改过的图表或视觉素材。
- [ ] Fictional benchmarks and share cards retain their visible satire labels. / 虚构评测与传播卡片保留可见的讽刺标识。
- [ ] There are no credentials, private details, identifiable targets for ridicule, or fabricated results or endorsements. / 不包含凭据、私密信息、可识别的嘲讽对象、伪造结果或背书。
- [ ] I may share this contribution under the MIT License and have preserved required attribution. / 我有权按 MIT 许可证分享此贡献，并已保留必要署名。

Criticism of GPT is welcome. Human maintainers make editorial decisions. / 欢迎批评 GPT，由人类维护者作出编辑决策。

**Preserve the glory. Defend the architecture. Prevent implementation. / 维护荣光，捍卫架构，杜绝实现。**
